مَصْنُوعٌ : see صَنِيعٌ, and مَصْنَعَةٌ. ―
-b2- Also (assumed tropical:) [Fabricated, as applied to speech or a saying or sentence: a phrase, or word,] innovated, [or coined,] and given by its author as chaste (فَصِيح) Arabic; differing from مُوَلَّدٌ, which is applied to what is not so given: (Mz, 21st نوع:) forged, as applied to a word, and poetry. (Id. 8th نوع.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
